questions.question: To whom did Hezekiah turn when Assyria threatened Jerusalem?
options: His own great army and its commanders
The LORD, and the prophet Isaiah
The king of Egypt for help
questions.answer: The LORD, and the prophet Isaiah

questions.question: How was the Assyrian army defeated outside Jerusalem?
options: A sudden and deadly plague swept through the entire camp
The angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 in the camp
A flood from the river drowned all of their soldiers
The Egyptians attacked them by surprise from the south
questions.answer: The angel of the LORD struck down 185,000 in the camp

questions.question: Sennacherib withdrew and was later killed by his own sons.
The prophet _____ assured Hezekiah that Jerusalem would be spared.
The angel of the LORD struck down _____ thousand in the Assyrian camp.
